ports.label: Multiviewer Out
ports.note: 2 dedicated 4K multiviewer outputs. Card is HDMI 2.0 or DP 1.2 depending on the card reference (taken from the Aquilon C datasheet; confirm for Cmini).

ports.label: Genlock Loop Out
ports.note: Loop out of the dedicated sync BNC

ports.label: Dante (primary + secondary)
ports.note: Dual redundancy Ethernet ports, AES67 support, 64x64 @48 kHz. RJ45 type from the Aquilon family quick start guide.

ports.label: USB
ports.note: From the Aquilon family quick start guide (Cmax: 2x USB). Not confirmed in the Cmini datasheet. Also has an OLED display and a standby button.

ports.label: USB
ports.note: 2 on front panel (USB type assumed A); front also has OLED display and standby button

ports.label: Tally / GPI-O
ports.note: Box includes 3x MCO 5-pin connectors; exact connector type/count of GPIO not confirmed

slots.label: Input connector card slot
slots.note: 2 swappable input cards. Models: 4x HDMI 2.0, 8x HDMI 1.4, 4x fiber SC (HDMI 2.0), 4x DisplayPort 1.2/1.4, 8x 3G-SDI, 4x 12G-SDI, plus NDI/SDVoE/ST 2110/SFP options. Max 8x 4K60p or 16x 2K/DL inputs
